overview.Module Title: Industrial Advances in Film and TV

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The module requires the students to acquire the relevant knowledge, skills and experience on creation of movie and TV plays, and proficiently create and adapt movie and TV plays. It also aims to enhance the basic theoretical attainment and practical writing skills in the major of play adaption for the students, gradually cultivate the professional attainments of each student in movie and TV play adaption, and lay a foundation for development in movie and TV industry.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Identify the fundamental knowledge, laws and methods on writing of movie and TV plays, and managing the source materials, subjects and themes of movie and TV plays B Acquire the basic skills of movie and TV agencies, languages of movie and TV plays, and adapt movie and TV plays. C Identify transactions of intellectual property rights and plays, intrinsic relations between the movie and TV industrial layout, and operation of feature towns of a focal organisation.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Classroom teaching, lectures and creative practice.
